name: get_tool_details
description: Show the full input schema of a tool found via search_tools. Pass the exact tool name from the search results.

name: search_tools
description: Search for available tools by capability. Returns matching tool names with one-line descriptions and makes those tools available: call one directly, or call get_tool_details on a name to see its full schema. Natural-language query by default; set regex:true to match a regular expression if the natural-language search can't find the tool. Discoverable tool groups: fusion, mcp.
